title: Timeline document and patch vocabulary
summary: The Video Project timeline at rest and its pure editing vocabulary. Fifteen operations are validated before the storage broker runs. History lives beside timeline, not inside it. Runtime HTTP revision checks and execution receipts surround this Python seam.

carrier.notes: File describes data at rest; the listed patch operations are Python calls at the named seams, not file-system RPCs. JSON Schema cannot express source-range arithmetic, adjacency, finite Python numbers or exact six-place rounding; the operation notes and invariants supply those rules. Gate execution_id is execution_ plus the first 32 hex characters of SHA-256 over canonical product/account/session/root-turn/turn/capability/resource-scope data. Scope includes project_revision and authorization context. A proven-not-started step terminalizes RELEASED; the identical request replays its failed outcome, rather than running again.

replaceability.why: Holds Project integrity or trusted execution authority; replacing it requires Lumeri control.

reach.notes: Trusted Runtime seam, not an additional grant to a creator Luc.

operations.name: insert_clip
operations.notes: No operation deadline is enforced at this seam. Insert one unique clip on an existing track, replacing its track and start with track_id and at. at defaults to zero. ripple defaults false and pushes clips at/after the insertion on that track. validate_patch then apply_patch is pure and does not itself write or advance revisions. Through bind_timeline_patch the Gate uses execution_id for replay; durable success advances revision by one. The current broker serializes a document edit with its revision under a mutation lease, but writes document.json and project.json separately. It has no single crash-atomic client_op_id result-record commit. It is not yet eligible for replaceable writes under the self-Luc run gate.

operations.name: undo
operations.notes: No operation deadline is enforced at this seam. Restore the newest undo snapshot and push the current timeline onto redo. Refuse an empty stack. This is a fresh durable revision, not a decrement. validate_patch then apply_patch is pure and does not itself write or advance revisions. Through bind_timeline_patch the Gate uses execution_id for replay; durable success advances revision by one. It has no single crash-atomic client_op_id result-record commit. It is not yet eligible for replaceable writes under the self-Luc run gate. HTTP checks current history before replay; a retry after consuming the last entry can return nothing_to_undo.

bounds.name: insert_clip_limit
bounds.unit: clips checked by insert_clip and with_clips

bounds.name: history_byte_target
bounds.unit: canonical bytes per stack, except a single oversized snapshot

invariants.text: Applying the same validated patch to the same document yields the same result and leaves the input untouched.
A successful governed patch advances the Project revision. An identical insert request replays without a second edit; undo/redo have a pre-gate availability limitation recorded below.
A fresh request naming a stale Project revision is refused with HTTP 409 before the Project changes.
Undo restores the previous timeline bytes for every non-history operation.
For governed calls, a definitive no-side-effect failure is RELEASED and the identical execution identity replays that failure. A new attempt must not be disguised as a retry.

break: An unhandled exception, invalid output, or failed declared artifact check.
failure.notes: The original reports failure today. The self-Luc run gate and original fallback are requirements for a future replacement, not a promise this seam already implements.

conformance.notes: Existing tests cover original edits, compatibility, revision refusal and exact replay; replacement execution and contract output validation are not wired.

known_deviations.text: The current broker serializes a document edit with its revision under a mutation lease, but writes document.json and project.json separately. It has no single crash-atomic client_op_id result-record commit. It is not yet eligible for replaceable writes under the self-Luc run gate.
upsert_asset, segment_edit, duplicate_clip and remove_track are explicitly unported and refused. A replacement must not silently add them to this major.
The history byte target is not an absolute maximum: one newest snapshot is retained even if it alone exceeds 1048576 bytes.
Track locked and muted are stored settings; apply_patch does not use locked as a write authorization check. Split also does not check the 4096 insertion ceiling.
The execution journal stores immutable effect results separately from Project persistence. It does not make the Project document, revision and client_op_id result record one atomic commit.

Undo/redo availability is checked before Gate replay lookup. After undo consumes the final undo snapshot, an identical retry can return nothing_to_undo rather than replaying its successful receipt; redo has the symmetric limitation.

timeline.description: Default: 1920x1080, 30 fps, zero duration, V1 video and A1 audio, empty clips and markers. Existing fields pass through. An edit derives duration from clip ends, orders clips by track_id/start/id, and markers by moment/id. Stored documents are not globally revalidated against all insertion ceilings.

clip.description: Stored clip extensions, including effects, transition_after, text_config and waveform data, survive edits. The nine normalized fields are always present. Values and legacy extras are kept rather than reinterpreted. Input normalization checks at most 64 original fields, then inserts missing normalized defaults.

new_clip.description: New clips reject unknown fields. Non-text needs a non-empty asset_id; source_out must exceed source_in; duration equals their difference after rounding to six decimals. These relational checks are enforced by normalize_clip.

marker.description: Stored markers keep extensions and their at/time spelling. Both moments, when present, must agree. New markers are written with time, kind and label.

motion.description: SVG viewBox 0 0 1000 1000, one safe path, at most 16384 UTF-8 bytes and 128 path commands. Defaults ease_in_out, no auto rotation and zero rotations. Executable/external SVG content is refused.
